block_node.block_desc:
Filter real or complex input with an FIR filter optimized for HDL code generation.
Choose from fully-parallel Direct form systolic or Direct form transposed structures or a Partly serial systolic structure with configurable serialization parameters. All structures share multipliers in symmetric or antisymmetric filters. Both systolic structures make efficient use of Intel and Xilinx DSP blocks.
When using programmable coefficients, set Coefficients prototype to a coefficient vector that is representative of the symmetry and zero-value locations of the expected coefficients.The block uses this prototype to optimize multipliers in the filter implementation. When numerator source is 'Input port (Memory interface)', the block also uses the prototype to indicate filter length. When numerator source is 'Input port (Parallel interface)' and your coefficients are unknown or not expected to share symmetry or zero-value locations, set Coefficients prototype to [].
block_node.keywords: Discrete FIR Filter HDL Optimized,HDL Optimized Discrete FIR Filter
